headline: Hot Money Floods In, Stocks and Currency Both Rise; New Taiwan Dollar Breaks Into 31.6 Intraday, Up Four Days in a Row | Industry
summary: Taiwan stocks closed at record highs on AI-driven hot money inflows, and the New Taiwan dollar closed at 31.708 per US dollar, up for four consecutive days.
why: The Taiwan stock index reflects listed companies and the New Taiwan dollar sets the currency value for Taiwan's trade and investment flows.
why_moved: The article attributes the inflows to AI-themed hot money, which lifted both stocks and the currency.
